opening.argument: The presenter markets StrongBlock as a passive-income opportunity built on paid node participation. He says viewers must exchange tokens for a node, requiring 10 STRONG, and accept a recurring monthly maintenance fee. In return, he presents one node as producing three tokens, or $1,459.89 every month passively, and describes the arrangement as a 100-day return on investment—an apparent path to recovering the initial investment and earning thousands monthly. The presentation further promotes a Bitcoin reward through Celsius, conditioned on opening an account and transferring $400 in assets. These are consequential financial requests paired with confident recurring-return claims, presenting the opportunity as reliably generating money.
